title: Flow/session spine: entry-guard + opening-run + draft save/resume through the set
recipe: frontend-plan/SIBLING-SET-PLAN.md §8 G-E (entry-guard/opening-run authoring — no recipe) + §8 G-H (flow-only keys — no recipe); plan is exemplar transposition from sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/flow/{entry-guard.js,run.js} and features/import-type-filter/controller.js

filesToTouch.what: Complete the pp-007 skeleton to the full live-animals policy (exemplar sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/flow/entry-guard.js, transposed). Exports: guardedJourneyPath(path) — true only for paths under `${BASE}/notifications/` that are not createPath(), not an action slug (ACTION_SLUGS = new Set(['amend','cancel-amend','copy','delete'])), and not the entry surface (importTypePage.slug or any subpath of it); hasCommittedNotificationAnswers(answers) — an answer counts only when its key is a manifest obligation (obligationByName from the post-pp-005 bridge/obligation-source surface), is not the flow-only 'importType' key, is not in the policy-derived systemPopulated view (plant policy.systemPopulated is [], so no exclusions in practice), and isAnswered(value); entryGuardTarget(request, h) — null for unguarded paths, null when hasEnteredThroughFilter(request, journeyId) (L2 flow/run-state.js), null when hasCommittedNotificationAnswers(answers), else pagePath(request.params.journeyId, importTypePage.slug). Imports: shared/paths.js (BASE, createPath, pagePath), lib/answered.js, engine/read.js get, bridge/obligation-source.js (whatever export shape pp-005 landed), flow/run-state.js, the set's features/import-type/page.js. G-E contract satisfied: entryGuardTarget returns a redirect path or falsy; its only L2 reads are engine read + run-state + obligation-source.

Complete the pp-007 skeleton to the exemplar shape (sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/flow/run.js): flowPageTarget(page) helper via pageGatePasses (L2 flow/gates.js) + pagePath; RUN_STEPS = [{ id: importTypePage.id, target: flowPageTarget(importTypePage) }] — import-type ONLY at m0 (brief; m2 increments extend); nextRunTarget(stepId, scope, journeyId) finds stepId, walks later steps returning the first non-null target, falls back to hubPath(journeyId). No other exports.

Unit pins for the opening run at m0: nextRunTarget(importTypePage.id, scope, journeyId) returns hubPath(journeyId) (no later steps); nextRunTarget with an unknown stepId returns null; RUN_STEPS has exactly one step whose id is importTypePage.id. Mirror the live-animals run.test.js idiom (behavioural, no mocking of L2).

Unit pins for guard policy: guardedJourneyPath — false for createPath(), false for each action slug (amend/cancel-amend/copy/delete), false for the import-type slug and its subpaths, false for non-journey paths, true for a journey page slug and for the hub; hasCommittedNotificationAnswers — {} and { importType: 'plants' } are false, an answered manifest-obligation key is true (compose a small fixture manifest via configureObligationSet, the bridge characterisation-test pattern, since the real plant manifest is empty at m0); entryGuardTarget — fresh journey deep-link resolves the import-type page path, entered-through-filter session returns null, committed-answers journey returns null, unguarded path returns null.

Complete the flow-spine mechanics per the live-animals import-type-filter exemplar (features/import-type-filter/controller.js): meta = { ...page, collects: ['importType'] }; GET does state.get() once and prefills values.importType from answers; POST validates with compose(requiredOneOf('importType', <option values seeded by pp-007>, copy.errors.importTypeRequired)) — invalid re-renders raw values with kit.errorSummary, status 400; valid POST wraps state.commit(request, h, values) in kit.recoverableSave (marked failure re-renders with recoverableError:true, status 500; other errors throw) — importType is a FLOW_ONLY_KEY (FD-8) so the engine routes the commit to the session flow-only store (plantProductsFlowOnlyAnswers), never records; shouldOpenRun = inOpeningRun(request, journeyId) || !hasCommittedNotificationAnswers(answersBeforeCommit); when opening: beginOpeningRun(request, h, journeyId) then redirect kit.exitTarget(request, nextRunTarget(page.id, scope, journeyId)) — at m0 this lands on the hub; otherwise redirect await kit.nextTarget(request, page, scope). Do NOT build the pp-017 surface here: caption/H1 full copy, the 4-option certificate list, c-024 handling and first-save reference minting UX remain pp-017's; keep pp-007's seeded options and only guarantee the CHED-PP/plants option continues.

Extend the pp-007 skeleton tests to pin the spine: GET prefill from flow-only answers; empty POST → 400, raw values re-rendered, nothing committed; valid POST commits importType to the flow-only store and NOT to canonical fulfilment/records; fresh journey valid POST begins the opening run and redirects to the hub (nextRunTarget exhausted at m0); journey with committed manifest answers redirects via kit.nextTarget (no opening run restart); marked recoverable-save failure → 500 re-render with recoverableError; unexpected error throws.

Ensure errors.importTypeRequired = 'Select the type of import' — the single canonical Joi-voice string (c-018, page-spec validationMessages[0]). Add only if the pp-007 skeleton lacks it; no other copy changes (full page copy is pp-017).
Welsh counterpart of errors.importTypeRequired with the identical leaf path and value kind (copy-parity enforced). Update copy/copy.test.js in the same folder if key coverage is pinned there.

Add the flow-spine scenarios listed under specs (deep-link guard, opening-run happy path, draft resume round-trip, validation error state with c-004/c-014 assertions, axe both states). Keep pp-007's existing render assertions; every test starts its own notification; raw role/label locators, no page objects, no sleeps.

Add a 'Standing defaults (recorded once — not per-page ACs)' section: (1) c-018 — validation is single-layer Joi-voice ('Enter/Select the …'), ONE canonical string per field, backend 'Add the …' variants rejected; (2) c-004 — error-summary title is GDS 'There is a problem' everywhere (never IPAFFS 'Please fix the following errors'); (3) c-014 — radios/fieldset pages use H1-inside-legend with caption above (govuk legend-as-heading), fixing the IPAFFS empty-legend defect. These are L2-free defaults every downstream page increment inherits.

flowChanges.entryGuard: entryGuardTarget completed: fresh deep-links to guarded journey pages (any /notifications/{journeyId}/{slug} except the create path, the action slugs amend|cancel-amend|copy|delete, and the import-type entry surface) redirect to the import-type filter, unless the session entered through the filter (flow/run-state.js) or any manifest-obligation answer is committed. importType itself and system-populated keys never count as user progress (plant policy.systemPopulated = []).

acceptanceCriteria: A fresh-session deep link to any guarded journey page redirects (302) to the import-type filter; the create path, action slugs (amend, cancel-amend, copy, delete) and the import-type surface itself are never intercepted.
After entering through the filter, or once any manifest-obligation answer is committed, the guard passes — no redirect loop; hub and journey pages reachable directly.

A valid import-type submit commits importType to the flow-only session store (plantProductsFlowOnlyAnswers) — never to records/canonical fulfilment — begins the opening run, and redirects via nextRunTarget, which at m0 resolves to the hub.
RUN_STEPS contains exactly the import-type step; nextRunTarget(importTypePage.id, scope, journeyId) returns hubPath(journeyId); unknown stepId returns null.

Draft round-trip proven end-to-end in stub mode: creating a journey mints a GBN-PP reference through the records service, the dashboard lists the DRAFT, and re-entry renders the hub with the same reference (stub semantics identical to real per pp-008).

Empty submit re-renders status 400 with the single canonical string 'Select the type of import' (c-018), a GDS 'There is a problem' error summary linking to the control (c-004), and legend-as-heading composition (c-014).
The three FD-3 session cookies ride configureSession under SERVED_SET=plant-products; no liveAnimals* cookie is set.

notes: Re-interpretation of inc-003: the routing/validation spine already exists in L2 — this increment completes and PROVES the set's flow/session policy on top of pp-007's skeleton files, with pp-008's records adapter underneath. Exemplars (transpose, do not invent): sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/flow/entry-guard.js (guard policy verbatim shape), flow/run.js (RUN_STEPS/nextRunTarget shape), features/import-type-filter/controller.js (flow-only commit + beginOpeningRun + kit.exitTarget redirect), flow/flow.js:32-36 (start section already mirrored by pp-007 per FD-13 — no sections change here). Rulings applied: FD-8 (importType + declaration are FLOW_ONLY_KEYS riding session, not the manifest; declaration's page is pp-039 — only the key membership exists now), FD-3 (plantProducts* cookie names), FD-13 (start section holds dashboard + import-type; RUN_STEPS are additional to section membership), c-018/c-004/c-014 recorded once in docs/README.md as standing defaults so per-page increments never re-litigate them. P-1 interplay: live-animals' entry-guard imports SYSTEM_POPULATED from bridge/obligation-source — after pp-005 that surface is policy-derived; the plant guard must consume the landed shape (plant policy.systemPopulated = [], so the exclusion set is empty but the code path stays uniform). Division of labour vs pp-017: this increment owns MECHANICS (guard, opening run, session commit, resume); pp-017 owns the full page spec (caption 'About the consignment', H1, 4-option list, exact option vocabulary, c-024 overdue-debtor gate rejection, first-save minting UX). The e2e validation scenario added here uses the canonical message since c-018 fixes it now; pp-017 re-verifies against the full page spec. Guard unit tests need a non-empty manifest to prove hasCommittedNotificationAnswers=true — compose a fixture set via configureObligationSet (bridge characterisation-test pattern), since the real plant manifest is empty until pp-018.
